with matching titles: zero missing, zero fabricated. Four load-bearing claims re-checked against
paper text rather than scout paraphrase, two of which the scouts had themselves flagged as
secondhand. One web-derived figure ("steerability emerges at ~68% of training") was NOT in the
paper and is dropped rather than quoted. One scout-reported id (2503.17942) resolves to an
unrelated colloidal-physics paper; nothing in the review depends on it. Coverage bound stated
honestly: the Semantic Scholar keyword channel was rate-limited (HTTP 429) on ~19 of ~20 calls
across all four scouts, so the negative result rests on arXiv, OpenAlex, web and the citation
graph rather than on a complete sweep.

FINDING 1 — NOVELTY HOLDS, AND IS NOW PRECISELY STATEABLE. No retrieved work fits a linear map
from a pooled context hidden state to a pooled hidden state of the model's OWN generated answer
and reports held-out predictivity; none fits any close relative across a pretraining checkpoint
ladder. Two scouts reached this independently through disjoint channels after dedicated probes.
Eight nearest misses are tabulated, each failing on a NAMED axis rather than vaguely. The closest
is ParaScopes (2511.00180), which fits a linear map to the model's own upcoming paragraph but
targets an external SONAR embedding and scores by tiered similarity. The second closest, LRE
(2308.09124), needed correction: it is a Jacobian first-order approximation from a single prompt,
not a corpus-fitted regression with held-out R-squared, which widens rather than narrows the gap.

FINDING 2 — THE LADDER HAS A STRUCTURAL BLIND SPOT, AND IT IS KNOWABLE BEFORE ROUND 1. Applying
the verified emergence law of 2511.16893 (U_PT = T / (B^0.37 C^0.62), alpha = 13.26) at Olmo-3's
own configuration (B = 1024 sequences x C = 4096 tokens) predicts the induction-head phase
transition at ~step 254, i.e. ~1.07B tokens. The ladder's first non-zero rung is step 1000
(4.19B tokens), and I confirmed against the Hub that stage-1 checkpoints are spaced every 1000
steps with no exceptions at the bottom. So that transition falls entirely inside the single gap
between rung 0 and rung 1, cannot be resolved, and cannot be densified into: no checkpoints exist
down there. This partly answers planner open-decision 2 in advance. The compensating good news is
that the log spacing brackets the LATER function-vector-scale transition under both plausible
transfer rules from Pythia (token-matched ~step 8,000; fraction-matched ~step 155,000; rungs at
5,000 / 21,000 / 60,000 / 143,000 / 286,000 span both) — a real virtue of the design that was
previously unstated. Extrapolation caveat recorded: Olmo-3 sits ~2x beyond the law's fitted grid
in the law's own units.

FINDING 3 — H1 IS NOT THE CONSENSUS IT READS AS. The disconfirming-evidence pass changed the
conclusion. Timing evidence splits by WHAT is measured: circuit-level structure forms early
(induction heads at step 1,000 of 143,000 in Pythia, verified verbatim), while content-level
linear readouts — the family our object belongs to — emerge at INTERMEDIATE stages (2508.01892,
verified verbatim), with function-vector heads at ~11% of training rising "gradual[ly] but
sustained". One paper documents structure forming and then being LOST mid-pretraining
(2606.26050: 0.94 on held-out probes by step 925, near zero by step 3,500). H1 stays a live
hypothesis; the experiment now adjudicates between two camps, which is a stronger motivation than
the body currently claims, and the plan should not pre-commit to an early transition.

DESIGN CONSEQUENCES, eight ranked in the artifact. The one worth surfacing here costs NO NEW
COMPUTE: 2508.01892 verifies that "even closely related concepts exhibit steerability emergence
at distinct stages of training", so a single pooled formation curve can smear several distinct
formation events into one smooth ramp. The #1902 corpus already carries class labels (generic
16,000 / mathcode 1,200 / gsm8k 500 / mbpp 300), so reporting D(T) PER CONTEXT CLASS is the same
cells under a different aggregation and converts a possible artifact into a result. Also: the
Procrustes headline is now literature-grounded (2108.01661's sensitivity/specificity battery),

plan must state rather than paper over: the literature's preferred reference band is a seed-pair
null, and Olmo-3 is a single pretraining run, so we cannot construct one.

# ORCHESTRATOR-VERIFIED ELEVATION — sliding-attention window vs the 4-shot arm (Goal quantity 4)

Origin: Codex alternatives-lens item (D), filed by Codex as UNVERIFIED -> Concern. Orchestrator
probed it against the live Hub config and it promotes to MUST-FIX grade. Carrying it into Phase 3.

## The architecture fact (probed 2026-08-24, allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B @ main AND @ stage1-step0)

    sliding_window     : 4096
    num_hidden_layers  : 32
    layer_types        : {'sliding_attention': 24, 'full_attention': 8}
    full_attention idxs: [3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, 31]     <- every 4th layer only
    sliding idxs       : all 24 others

Identical at both the earliest rung and main, so this is a ladder-wide invariant, not a
late-stage config change.

## Why it bites THIS experiment

1. The plan's own length budget puts 4-shot sequences past the window. Plan line 486:
   "2,880 + prompt <= 3,072 + answer 1,024 <= 8,192". So k16 rows reach ~6,976 tokens and the
   headline 4-shot (k=4, 4 x 180 = 720-token block) reaches ~4,816 — BOTH exceed 4,096.
2. In a sequence longer than 4,096, the answer tokens at the end CANNOT attend to the context
   tokens in 24 of the 32 layers. Only the 8 full-attention layers see the whole span.
3. The captured band is sliding-dominated BY CONSTRUCTION. Band B5 = {layer* +-0, +-2, +-4}
   (plan line 141); full-attention layers are spaced every 4, so a +-2/+-4 band around ANY layer*
   is mostly sliding layers — and if layer* itself is sliding, the entire band is. Precedent: the
   parent #1902's own best layers were L31 (full_attention) for base but L18 (SLIDING) for all
   three post-trained stages.
4. The 0-shot arm is SHORT and therefore unaffected. So the confound is ARM-DIFFERENTIAL, exactly
   where Goal quantity 4 lives: Delta(T) = 4-shot minus 0-shot diagonal. Delta could go down
   because the context fell out of the attention window, which is architecturally indistinguishable
   from "in-context examples substitute for the map" as the plan currently reads it.

## The gap in the plan

The plan RECORDS sliding_window 4096 three times as a verified config fact (lines 11, 414, and
assumption A2) and pins max_model_len=8192 — but nowhere reasons about the window against the
4-shot length budget or the probed-layer band. Recording the constant is not the same as
propagating it. A2's verify step ("P1 reads AutoConfig per ALL 15 pinned revisions") re-reads the
number; it does not test the interaction.

Note this also sharpens Claude's alternatives concern C6 (format-vs-map fusion) and the Claude
Alternatives disposition on tokenizer/context-window drift, which treated the window question as
covered by the max_model_len pin. The pin bounds TOTAL length; it does not bound
context-to-answer DISTANCE inside the sliding layers.

## What Phase 3 should require (planner picks; do not pre-decide the fix here)

- A registered per-arm, per-rung DIAGNOSTIC: the fraction of rows whose context-token-to-answer-
  token distance exceeds 4,096, reported for 0-shot, 4-shot, and each k dose. This is the minimum;
  it converts a silent confound into a measured one.
- Either a layer-type-aware read (report the band split by sliding vs full_attention, or constrain
  layer* / an additional full-attention comparison layer from {3,7,11,15,19,23,27,31}), or an
  explicit argument why a sliding-layer pooled state still carries the context for over-window rows.
- A short-row bounded subset (rows whose full 4-shot sequence fits under 4,096) as the clean
  within-window read for Delta(T), with the over-window rows reported separately rather than
  pooled.
- If none of the above is adopted, Delta(T) must be scope-labelled as bundling an architectural
  window effect, and the H3 kill condition re-stated accordingly.

## Cost

Diagnostic (1) is free — it is a token-count over sequences the run already builds. The bounded
subset re-read is a re-aggregation of already-captured cells, not new capture. A full-attention
comparison layer would add capture layers, so that one is the only option with a compute cost, and
it is bounded by the existing 17-layer capture budget if a full-attention layer is already inside
the captured set.

- `scripts/issue2544_run.py:528`: capture resume fingerprints do not bind the consumed rollout artifact.
  - Evidence: both capture kinds initialize `rollout_sha=None` (`:528`, `:557`); `UnitQueue.init` compares only that stored fingerprint at `scripts/issue2544_common.py:390-399`. The real hash computed at `issue2544_run.py:656` is stored only under `info` at `:682-683`.

- `scripts/issue2544_common.py:468`: claimed queue units have no lease recovery.
  - Evidence: claims become `running` with a timestamp, but `init()` never resets dead-owner/stale claims; `worker_loop` sleeps while `any_running()` remains true at `scripts/issue2544_run.py:709-720`.
  - Impact: SIGKILL, OOM, or pod-worker loss leaves a permanent `running` unit. Every surviving or resumed worker eventually sleeps forever and finalize cannot complete.
  - Fix: Add owner-PID/heartbeat leases and reclaim demonstrably dead or expired claims during initialization and polling.
  - Mechanizable: yes — seed a queue with a stale `running` unit and dead owner, then assert relaunch reclaims it.

  - Impact: Once the tail of a wave has fewer runnable units than GPUs, GPUs idle even though independent cells in later waves are ready.
  - Fix: Use a shared dependency/resource-aware queue that stages/admit-reaps asynchronously up to the disk cap.
  - Mechanizable: yes — simulate uneven unit durations and assert an idle worker can begin a later-rung ready unit before the current wave fully drains.
